name: Shallowing — Catching
summary: Amelia's 'catch': press the tip against the opening and move up/down so it snags or catches at the entrance, then slips in just a tiny bit each pass—creating a thud sensation and internal friction on the way out.

Press the tip (finger, toy head, or penis) against the opening and move up and down so it 'catches' at the entrance and then dips in just slightly each pass. The repeated catch-and-release produces a satisfying thud sensation, and the exit rubs the walls for lovely internal friction.

3. Let it slip in just a tiny bit on each pass.

Use lube so the catch feels good, not dry or rough.
